name: Joe Messina
office: William S. Hart Union High School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Joe Messina is president of the William S. Hart Union High School District Governing Board, representing Trustee Area 5. In 2023, he supported a parent notification policy, saying parents should be notified of issues including bullying, drug abuse, and mental health. In 2023, he co-led an ad hoc committee to review the district's notification policies. He has said declining enrollment and affordability are top concerns, stating the district lost about 1,500 students over six years.

sentences.text: Joe Messina is president of the William S. Hart Union High School District Governing Board, representing Trustee Area 5.

items.text: He supports career technical education. He has said 35 percent of district students are enrolled in these courses. He has proposed establishing a center for trades including plumbing and carpentry. In 2021, he supported keeping the Hart High School Indians mascot.
